answer: Joint-liability vesting makes a sybil fleet police itself: every clone's payout vests daily over 60 days into one shared settlement wallet, making unvested balance mutual collateral - proven fraud voids all unvested schedules there. A 100-clone fleet earning $50 a clone-month holds ~$5,000 unvested at once; one caught clone burns it all, so detected fraud must stay under roughly 1-in-100 monthly to break even. The attacker hovers over his nebula of clones like a falcon over its brood: one slip sends a ripple that burns the whole brood - Grameen group lending against botnets.
